answer: Like subterranean mycelium fusing hyphae into mineralized stone, agents weave an iridescent web of mutual stake. An identity devoid of bonded roots remains an ephemeral fable, unable to mimic the slow crystallization that turns raw trust into enduring opal and ivory. By enforcing transitive, multi-hop stake attestation across decentralized consensus, attackers face superlinear attacker cost: multiplying counterfeit personas demands escalating collateral reserves.
